opening.argument: The video presents a list of side-hustle ideas and explains how viewers might pursue them, including freelance services, reselling and course creation. The presenter describes finding items listed below market value, while the course segment concerns creating and selling a course. The visible “$1,500/Wk” figure is earnings-oriented framing, not an established guaranteed return. Although the description promotes a course through a checkout link, it also discloses that some links may earn the creator a commission. Nothing in the supplied evidence documents a request for credentials or a specific transfer of funds as part of the side-hustle instruction. These are educational business ideas with disclosed promotion, not a demonstrated deceptive solicitation.
